- gross hematuria
- intermittent right pelvic pain
- tubular filling defect with partial obstruction of the right mid ureter
- pedunculated ureteral tumor

- hypertension
- psoriasis

- 60-pack-year smoking history
- microscopic hematuria
- normal biochemical tests

- 5 cm long tubular mass in the mid ureter

2. Ureteral transitional cell carcinoma
3. Ureteral leiomyoma
